title: Round 35's build faults: false check failures (form fields, carousel copies, the template's own repeats, Joomla picture paths) and the doors a build lacked (copy status, T4 logo, theme gettext words, labels, the installed record)
steps: S1: copy.status after a copy run whose words are in the row but not in the build the request read.

S2: photos-fit over a carousel strip with two copies of one slide, a selfie under a cover block's words, and three cards showing one photo where the template showed one badge three times (and where it did not).
S3: collected-used with the business's logo in four frames of a page where the template showed its mark in four.
S4: native-structure of a Joomla article whose picture and data-path changed and a menu item whose browser title changed; then with show_page_heading changed.
S5: the build fence on T4's local/etc/site/default.json, a cp into it, and a PHP imagepng over images/joomlart/logo/logo.png.
S6: copy: a pastry's $5.25 against research holding "price": "5.25"; a page of 85 blocks; copy.apply with words shown twice on the page, one asking for its count.

S7: content.find of a WordPress theme pattern line esc_html_e('Only $5.99', 'wp-ja-restaurant'), an _x() heading and a plain line; content.contract string on a quickstart WordPress site and on Joomla.

S8: header-brand on Joomla over two pages; no-demo-words with two EmDash categories left; cta-real to /contact/phone-reservation/ with the plan naming another contact page; structure.read {record}; changedSinceCheck after an EmDash restart and a shell sed.
expect: S1: the written pages, never COPY_NOT_STARTED.
S2: copies skipped; the selfie fails as a photo behind a section; the cards pass with the template's baseline and fail where the template had different pictures.
S5: local/etc/site open (file and cp); the PHP write refused naming media.import and local/etc/site.
S6: only $3.95 unsourced; three calls of 40, 40, 5 and one pack of 85; the repeated pairs placed with all:"page", then with expect 7.
S7: gettext {domain, msgid} and {domain, msgid, context}, the door names content.contract string; none for the plain line; relayed on WordPress, NOT_ON_THIS_PLATFORM on Joomla.
S8: the T4 local/etc/site place named once; taxonomy_update_term named once; the reservation page accepted; the record answered whole, an unknown one refused; both count as changes, a grep does not.
evidence: Local round 35 (26/10/2026): WordPress 31 min, failed after 8 checks (copy.write answered COPY_NOT_STARTED, 114 blocks retyped, native-structure 7 times, theme sidebar words with no door); EmDash 31 min, passed at check 7 after removing its contact form and hiding sector chips in /app; Joomla 28 min, failed after 8 checks (form inputs as empty boxes 8 times, 23 carousel-copy repeats, data-path and page_title as structure, logo written over the template's file).
fence: copy.status fresh read; img.clone/underWords; designRepeats; PAGE_WORDS_KEY + picture attributes; T4_SITE_SETTINGS + buildPictureWrite; BLOCKS_PER_CALL + amount; copy.apply all:page; gettextOf + string on WordPress; LABEL_DOOR; JOOMLA_LOGO_PLACE; RESERVATION_SLUG; structure.read record; servesAgain/shellWrites

tests: copy.status that read the build before the run wrote it answers the written words, not "not started"
photos-fit skips carousel copies, sees a photo under words, and keeps the repeats the template has
collected-used: the name, phone, email, street, an opening time, a review and own photos must all show
Joomla: a picture's data-path and a page's browser title follow the build; a setting changed does not
T4's site settings in local/etc/site are the site's; a picture written by hand outside tracy-content is refused
a price is held by its amount, whatever currency the research wrote around it
a page longer than one call takes is written in parts and kept as one pack
words shown in more than one place go again alone with all:"page", and with the count when it asks
a WordPress theme line printing the words through gettext names the string override, with its domain and msgid
string override reaches a quickstart WordPress site too; on Joomla it is refused with the Joomla road
header-brand: the collected logo in the header passes; the name alone, or another picture, does not
no-demo-words: a category or tag the template named fails while the page still names it, unless the brief does
cta-real: with the plan naming its contact page, a slug saying contact is not enough
structure.read with a record answers that record as the template installed it; an unknown one is refused
changedSinceCheck: a write or a photo after the latest verdict counts; another check or a refused write does not
